protocol.c2_retention: retain only with material eligible quality gain on meaningful supply-sufficient queries that justifies latency
protocol.c3_reopening: deferred unless C1/C2 complementary strengths or unsupported evidence-dependent constraints require it
protocol.objective: maximize semantic relevance subject to all supported hard constraints being satisfied

primary_metrics.eligible_fill_at_5: returned relevant-and-eligible / min(5, eligible supply); zero supply is not_applicable
primary_metrics.eligible_mrr: reciprocal rank of first returned relevant-and-eligible candidate
primary_metrics.eligible_ndcg_at_5: gain over relevant-and-eligible judgement universe; ineligible candidates contribute zero gain
primary_metrics.eligible_recall_at_10: retrieved relevant-and-eligible in Top-10 / all relevant-and-eligible in full judgement universe
primary_metrics.prohibited_constraint_violation_at_5: explicit exclusion violation / applicable returned Top-5 slots
primary_metrics.true_hard_negative_intrusion_at_5: returned structured hard-negative / returned Top-5 count

protocol.scarcity: zero eligible supply is not_applicable for Eligible Fill and excluded from supply-sufficient query decisions
